description: Checks one EU VAT ID (27 member states plus XI) or one Swiss UID live in the official register (VIES or the Swiss UID register). Returns valid / invalid / unavailable / format_error, the registered name and address where published, the source with the time of the check (UTC) and a ready-to-file record. Accepts any common spelling (spaces, dots, dashes, lower case, 'MWST'). Use before reverse-charge invoices or to verify a business partner.

expected_city.description: Optional: expected city, compared by VIES.

expected_name.description: Optional: the company name you expect. VIES compares it with the register where the country supports this (e.g. Spain).

expected_postal_code.description: Optional: expected postal code, compared by VIES.

expected_street.description: Optional: expected street, compared by VIES.

requester_vat_id.description: Optional: the user's OWN EU VAT ID. If given, VIES returns a consultation number as official proof of the check. Only pass it when the user provided their own VAT ID for this purpose.

vat_id.description: The VAT ID or Swiss UID, with country prefix, e.g. DE123456788, ATU12345675 or CHE-123.456.788 MWST.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: check_vat_id
title: Check VAT ID
